title: JobUpdatedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'job.updated'. Emitted at job-ledger status transitions (queued→active→completed/failed) so the admin jobs dashboard is live via the events socket instead of polling (STATE.md P4.13, Phase 4 deliverable D). Deliberately status-transition-granular, not progress-tick-granular: per-tick progress would flood the outbox on long scans; `progress` carries whatever the transition knew, and consumers poll GET /admin/jobs/{id} for finer detail while a job is active. `jobType` additively gained 'pg-upgrade' (STATE.md Phase 4 Open item, the boot-time embedded-PG major-upgrade audit row written directly via packages/jobs's createLedger export — never a real dispatched pg-boss job, see that package's PgUpgradeJobPayload doc comment). `attempts` mirrors the REST `Job` resource's own field (openapi.yaml's Job schema — the `jobs.attempts` column, 1-based, what the admin surface renders its "N attempts" chip from), so a live-merged row and a fetched row have identical anatomy. It is OPTIONAL, and the distinction is load-bearing: PRESENT means this transition is authoritative about the attempt count (packages/jobs's ledger emits the value the row write itself returned); ABSENT means the transition says nothing about it and a consumer must keep whatever it already had, never reset to 0. d4-f4: no emitter in this repo relies on ABSENT any more — the abandoned-job reconciliation sweep (packages/db/src/internal/jobs.ts) was the last one, and although it flips a stale row to 'failed' without TOUCHING the column it now reads and forwards the committed value, because a consumer that has never seen the row synthesizes it from this payload alone and an absent count there renders as 0 attempts / no chip. The ABSENT rule stays specified for forward compatibility with a future partial emitter; it is not a shape anything emits today.
